_doc: Pins of the parts whose CircuitQuest card lists none (graphgen/parts/arduino/pinouts.py)

74hc165.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Datasheet (74HC165 DIP-16, pin order 1-16: PL, CP, D4, D5, D6, D7, Q7N (/Q7), GND, Q7, DS, D0, D1, D2, D3, CE, VCC))

74hc595.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Datasheet (74HC595 DIP-16, pin order 1-16))

a4988.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Pololu-style A4988 breakout module printing (16-pin header, two rows of 8); GND duplicates numbered GND1 and GND2)

bmp180.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Common BMP180 breakout module (GY-68 style) printing; I2C interface. Some variants label VIN as VCC and omit 3V3 (4 pins). VIN is the main supply (3.3-5V on boards with regulator).)

dpdt-relay.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Approximate recollection of the Panasonic/Aromat KS2E-M-DC5 datasheet (8-pin, 5 V coil). I didn't check the pin order against the datasheet, so confirm it before wiring. The coil is non-polarised, so COIL+ and COIL- are only a convention.)

ds1307-rtc.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (DS1307 datasheet, 8-pin DIP/SOIC pinout (pin 1 = X1 through pin 8 = VCC))

ds18b20.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Datasheet (Maxim DS18B20, TO-92 package, pins 1-3 viewed from the flat face: GND, DQ, VDD))

epaper-2in9.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing (Waveshare 2.9" e-Paper module, SPI interface, 8-pin header))

gas-sensor.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing on the common 4-pin MQ-2 breakout board (VCC, GND, DO, AO); the bare MQ-2 sensor has 6 pins (A, H, A, H, B, B) but the breadboard module exposes these 4.)

hx711.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing on the common HX711 breakout board (4-pin digital side header: GND, DT, SCK, VCC; the load cell side has E+, E-, A-, A+, B-, B+ solder pads))

ili9341-lcd.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Printing on the common 2.8" SPI ILI9341 TFT module with touch (14-pin header); the first 9 pins are the display SPI, the last 5 are the XPT2046 touch controller.)

ili9341-touch-lcd.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing on the common 2.8" SPI ILI9341 capacitive-touch (FT6206 touch controller) breakout, e.g. LCDWiki MSP2833 version; LED is the backlight pin.)

ir-remote.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (The handheld IR remote has no pins. This pinout is for the matching IR receiver (VS1838B-type, 3-pin), taken from its datasheet. Some breadboard modules print the pins in a different order, so check the silkscreen.)

ky-040.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing: the common KY-040 board labels its 5 header pins CLK, DT, SW, +, GND in that order.)

led-matrix.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing: common WS2812B 8x8 matrix panels have a 3-pin input header labeled DIN, 5V, GND (a DOUT pad is often on the opposite side for chaining, but the standard input is these three pins).)

led-strip.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing: typical WS2812B strip connector marks 5V, DIN (data in), GND; the strip's 3-wire lead has bare/connector wires.)

logic-analyzer.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing on the common 8-channel USB logic analyzer (Saleae-style clone); it is powered over USB, so the probe header has no supply pin.)

max7219-matrix.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing: the common 8x8 MAX7219 module's input header is labelled VCC, GND, DIN, CS, CLK.)

mfrc522.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing on the common RC522 breakout board (8-pin male header, SPI mode; SDA is the chip-select/NSS line))

microsd-card.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing: the common 6-pin SPI microSD breakout for Arduino. Pin order varies a little between versions, and some boards print 3V3 and 5V as separate pins.)

mpu6050.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing on the common GY-521 breakout (8-pin header))

nlsf595.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Best recollection of the datasheet, not checked against it. I assumed the NLSF595 follows the 74HC595-style 16-pin layout, which is a guess. Check the pin order and names against the ON Semiconductor datasheet before wiring.)

nokia-5110-screen.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Common 8-pin Nokia 5110 (PCD8544) breadboard module as printed on the board; BL is the backlight input.)

ntc-temperature-sensor.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing on the common KY-013 style analog NTC thermistor module (3-pin header: - , + , S); S is the analog signal output.)

pal-tv.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Standard composite video (RCA) connector: center conductor carries the video signal, outer shield is ground. Arduino TVout uses a resistor-divided output pin (e.g., 1kΩ sync and 470Ω video) to the center conductor.)

photoresistor-sensor.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module printing: common 4-pin LDR sensor module (LM393 comparator) with VCC, GND, DO (digital out), AO (analog out). Some variants order pins AO, GND, VCC, DO.)

relay-module.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Common 1-channel 5V relay module (SRD-05VDC-SL-C) silkscreen: control header is VCC, GND, IN (sometimes labeled DC+, DC-, IN or S). The relay's switched contacts (COM, NO, NC) are on a separate screw terminal block and are not part of this header.)

sh1107-oled.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Seeed Grove OLED 1.12" (SH1107) I2C connector pinout, standard Grove order (SCL, SDA, VCC, GND), from the module's Grove interface)

tm1637-7segment.source: drafted by Claude, checked by code (Module's printing: the common 4-digit TM1637 breadboard module has a 4-pin male header labelled CLK, DIO, VCC, GND.)
